item.title: You've reached your weight loss goal on GLP-1 medications – what now?
item.description: Drugs like Ozempic and Wegovy have ushered in a new era in weight loss. But what happens after the weight comes off? And what should patients do when their progress suddenly stalls, even while still on a GLP-1 medication?

item.title: Pennsylvania deploys more resources to combat avian flu outbreaks at poultry farms
item.description: Pennsylvania is deploying more personnel and expanding testing as a highly contagious strain of bird flu kills millions of birds. About 7.1 million birds have died this year, with outbreaks in Philadelphia, Bucks and other counties.

item.title: Libraries pay 5 times more for e-books than consumers. N.J. lawmakers want to change that.
item.description: New Jersey librarians say publishers charge libraries up to five times consumer prices for e-books and restrict lending. A new bill would make such practices illegal under the state's consumer fraud law.

item.title: New Jersey’s balancing act: Cut utility bills without derailing clean energy
item.description: Gov. Mikie Sherrill declared a state of emergency on utility costs and ordered bill relief funded by clean energy programs after New Jersey electricity bills jumped 20 percent.

item.title: Offshore wind wins in court but still faces hurdles under Trump
item.description: Five East Coast offshore wind projects restarted construction after courts blocked Trump administration stop-work orders, but dozens of future projects face delays through 2029.

item.title: Kennett Winterfest returns with 50+ breweries, cideries and meaderies and a full live music lineup
item.description: Kennett Winterfest is scheduled for Saturday, Feb. 28, in Kennett Square, with craft beverage sampling and live music planned throughout the afternoon.

item.title: Eagles stay or go: Interior defensive line
item.description: Over the last few weeks, we've be taking a position-by-position look at which players will likely be back with the Philadelphia Eagles in 2026, and which ones likely won't. Today we'll continue on with the interior defensive linemen.

item.title: Phillies have 16 players playing in World Baseball Classic, is that good or bad?
item.description: Spring training will be a little different this year. The Phillies have a remarkable 16 players appearing in the World Baseball Classic, with 10 of them are likely to be on the team's 26-man roster.

item.title: Joel Embiid out for Sixers-Timberwolves on Sunday
item.description: Joel Embiid has missed four consecutive games, and the Sixers are 0-4 in those contests.

item.title: Instant observations: Sixers finally find flow, snap losing streak with emphatic win over Timberwolves
item.description: After their worst loss of the season, the Sixers went wire to wire as the better team in Minneapolis on Sunday night. Their dynamic backcourt dominated to stop the bleeding without Joel Embiid.
